claims.citation: New York Herald, 6 July 1866, p. 2, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Mauritius (Br), Nicolas, Gottenburg (?) June 6, via
Leith 16th, in ballast and with 770 passengers, to order. Had
strong westerly winds all the passage, and thick fogs since
passing the Banks. June 25, lat 45 50, lon 49 37, saw schr
Mary E Nason, fishing; July 2, lat 41 21, lon 64 34, saw a
steamer bound E, showing 3d dist pendant; 3d, lat 40 18, lon
64 34, bark Cupido (Br), steering E.

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Mauritius (Br.), Nicolas[?], Gateborg June 6, via Leith the
16th, in ballast and 770 pass. to order. The M. experienced strong
westerly winds the entire passage, and thick fogs since passing the
Banks. June 25, in lat. 45 50, long. 49 37, saw schr. Mary E. Nason,
fishing; 2d inst., in lat. 41 21, long. 64 34, saw a steamship, showing
third pendant, No. 457, bound E; 3d inst., in lat. 40 18, long. 64 34,
British bark Eupido[?], steering E.
